resources.string: Turbo control is not supported by this GPU driver
KGSL device is unavailable on this device
Turbo mode could not be changed. Try again while a game is running.
Current frequency is unavailable on this driver
Turbo requests the highest available clocks. Thermal limits still apply.

This application requests Turbo mode, which can keep the GPU at higher clocks while supported workloads are running.

1. Turbo mode is for Qualcomm Adreno GPUs, including newer A8XX devices when their vendor driver exposes Turbo control.
2. The application does not require ADB or root access.
3. Higher clocks can increase temperature and battery use.
4. GPU drivers differ by device and software version, so Turbo or frequency reporting may be unavailable.
5. Some devices release Turbo when the GPU becomes idle; enable it while the game is running.
6. If performance remains low after locking the screen, restart the device.
